Hey Marcus, Diego —

Thanks, 7/12 10:30am ET works for us. Quick answers:
1) Primary language: Node (backend) + React frontend.
2) Use-case: chat widget that uses streaming tokens to progressively render assistant replies; also a small batch summarization job for weekly transcripts.

Two quick operational questions before the call:
- For the sandbox, what are the default rate limits / concurrent request expectations? Will we be able to test sustained streaming for ~20 concurrent users?
- Do you provide temporary keys we can revoke post-eval or should we bring our own?

If you can provision temporary creds ahead of time that would be ideal so we can hit play during the session.

—Samir

Locked — calendar invite sent for Thu Jul 12, 10:30am ET (Zoom link included). Marcus: I provisioned a temporary demo key and scoping policy for Shoply; credential stub attached. Samir: the sandbox default rate limit for PLG eval seats is 60 requests/min with soft burst to 150 for 5 minutes (suitable for 15–25 concurrent small streaming sessions for short bursts). If you need higher sustained concurrency we can enable a reserved seat with Dedicated trial, but for the quick walkthrough this should let you exercise streaming.

Credentials (attached): sandbox_creds_stub.txt — contains placeholder API key and repro steps. Please treat it as ephemeral; Diego will revoke after 7 days unless you request extension.

See you Thursday.

Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
